document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Select a leader to approach: Rambeau, Blake, Crawford, or Jones. 
Select one of the following skills: Credit Rating, Persuade, Fast 
Talk, Intimidate, or Charm, then add any Cthulhu Mythos skill 
points you may have to that skill’s value. Make a 1D100 roll 
equal to or less than that sum, and go to 529. If you fail that 
roll, go to 574.
(510, 511)
